headline: Angelbird Media Usage and Compatibility Insights

coverage.summary: A user reported issues with SanDisk 128 GB cards in Sony A7III and A7RIII cameras, attributed to a firmware problem being addressed by Sony.

visibility_gaps: GPT retail/product sources are treated as unverified leads, not new verified social mentions.
methodology: Conducted a targeted search for Angelbird media usage, faults, compatibility, customer feedback, and creator demonstrations on Reddit, YouTube, DPReview, Blackmagic, RED, and Sony camera forums, focusing on posts and comments dated October 17, 2026. Extracted individual author comments with original URLs and dates, ensuring all findings are from the specified date.
